project_type: Expo React Native app with TypeScript, monorepo structure
build_system: Expo EAS with npm, npm scripts for running and building
build_command: npm run android or npm run ios (via Expo)
verification_instructions: Build the app using `npm run android` or `npm run ios`, navigate to the editor screen, verify audio panel opens without disabled message, test each bottom nav tool, and verify backend API calls succeed (check console logs)
environment_constraints: EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL must be set in .env (.env.local for dev); default is https://gullyfame.com/v1/api. The app requires native build for expo-audio (already installed). Use BASE_URL from axios config which strips trailing slashes to prevent double-slash issues
contribution_requirements: Follow existing service patterns in src/api/services/. All new services must use apiClient for requests. Use the ApiResponse<T> interface from src/api/types.ts. Auth token is automatically attached by axios interceptor (skipAuth: true for public endpoints). Service methods should handle both array and wrapped response formats for flexibility
key_patterns: Services export standalone functions and a default export object with all methods. Response handling normalizes field names (e.g., _id vs id, title vs name). Components fetch data on mount and show loading/empty states. Error handling includes Alert.alert for user-facing errors and console.error for debugging. Mock/fallback data provided for offline development
relevant_files: apps/gully-fame-mobile/app/(main)/upload/edit.tsx (audio disabled panel line ~675, editorTools array line ~460)
directory_structure: apps/gully-fame-mobile/src/api/services/ — all service files; apps/gully-fame-mobile/src/components/VideoEditor/ — tool panel components; apps/gully-fame-mobile/app/(main)/upload/edit.tsx — main editor screen
